title: 第3章  你敢来场生死战吗？
content_zh:
成真了……
楚弛的话，不停在四周飘荡。
声音铿锵，荡气回肠！
刷刷刷。
只是一瞬间，他就吸引了现场所有人的目光。
这一刻的他，万众瞩目。
“你是何人！胡说什么。”
庞家家主，庞庆洋冷声质问。
“我是谁？”
楚弛冷笑了一下，一把扯掉了面巾。
那一瞬间，全场鸦雀无声！
所有人瞪大了双眼，像是不敢相信自己的眼睛。
“是七少爷……是七少爷！”
“这是人是鬼啊。”
一些胆子小的下人，已经吓得变了脸色。
“有影子！七少爷，还活着。”
众人仔细一看，楚弛的身下，的确有影子。
他不是鬼，是人！
此刻，阳光洒在楚弛的身上，居然给人一种光芒万丈、不敢直视的感觉。
“楚弛！”

对面，庞妃烟瞳孔不停收缩，惊讶得已经说不出话来了！
楚弛怎么可能没有死。
那可是万丈深渊啊。
谁掉下去，都是死路一条，除非能飞！
“你现在的眼神，我很满意！是不是很惊讶，为什么我还活着？”
楚弛咧嘴一笑，笑容戏谑。
说着，他看向楚家家主，也就是他的爷爷，楚山。
“爷爷，我知道你从来都不待见我，但，我就问一句，如果楚家儿郎，蒙受大冤，当怎样？”
楚山眼神默然地看着楚弛，淡淡开口道：“有怨报怨，有仇报仇。”
“好。那就请爷爷，准许我杀了这婊子！”
楚弛指着庞妃烟的脸，身上，射出了一股强烈的杀意。
这杀意，现场所有人都察觉到了。
“你要杀庞妃烟？你不是很喜欢她吗？这到底怎么回事？”
“是啊，楚弛，你将话说明白一点。”
“好。”
楚弛刚想解释，庞妃烟看了一位庞家人一眼。
对方心领神会，手腕里忽然射出一道暗器。
暗器直击楚弛面门。
“不好！”
楚山和楚家的长辈面色一变，这么近的距离，想要出手也来不及。

还好，楚弛伸出右手，将暗器夹住了。
“嗯？”
庞妃烟眼神惊讶，这暗器，普通人根本不可能挡下来。
楚弛这个纨绔废物，是怎么做到的？巧合吗？
“庞家的人，你是不是太放肆了，这里是我楚家！”
楚山面色不悦，去到楚弛身边，亲自护住他。
“楚弛，你继续说，到底怎么回事……”
“爷爷，我是被这娘们陷害的！那一晚……”
楚弛将自己的遭遇讲了出来。
听了他的讲述，现场所有楚家人眼神惊讶。
谁都没想到，楚弛经历了这么憋屈的事情。
但，从他们的表情来看，明显有些不信。
庞妃烟不像是做这些事情的人啊？
相比于楚弛这个纨绔，他们似乎宁愿相信庞妃烟一些。
此时，楚山询问庞庆洋：“老庞，你有没有什么要解释的？”
庞庆洋反问道：“需要解释什么？当晚你们也亲眼看见测阳石碎了。”
“爷爷，那晚的测阳石，绝对是假的。”
“假的？”楚山眉头一皱，随后继续开口道，“这样，我楚家也有测阳石，我们重新测一下。楚枫，你去拿测阳石。”
此话落，楚弛连忙拦住了爷爷，他怎么可能重测！
重测，测阳石必定会碎。

因为这婊子，瞎猫碰到了死耗子，他真的是荒古大日体。
也就是说，如果庞妃烟不弄这一出戏，当晚夜里，他还真会暴走。
“爷爷，不用让二哥去拿测阳石。我现在还活着，不就是最好的证明吗？毕竟，我已经二十岁了！”
楚弛的话，让楚家人恍然大悟。
“对啊，七天过去，楚弛已经满二十岁了。他要是荒古大日体，就算没摔死，也爆体而亡了。”
“这么说，他说的是真的？庞妃烟真的如此蛇蝎心肠？但我怎么那么不愿意相信呢？”
“是啊，我也不信。”
楚家的人，还是不相信楚弛，由此可见，楚弛在楚家的地位，非常低！
唯有一个十七八岁的少女，咬牙道：“我相信七哥，七哥绝对不会拿这种事情撒谎。”
这女子，叫楚盈盈，排行老八。
整个楚家，除了楚弛的亲哥哥楚天，就她同楚弛的关系最好。
“八妹，你信楚弛？”
“嗯，会不会是庞妃烟觉得七哥不是修者，配不上她，所以才想出如此恶毒的计策，要弄死七哥？庞妃烟，或许就是一个下头女！”
楚盈盈的话，让庞庆洋皱起了眉头，他开口道：“楚弛说的话，毕竟是他的一面之词，或许，当晚他的记忆，已经混乱了。我不信妃烟会那样对他。”
楚山问道：“你的意思是，妃烟没有给他下药？”
庞庆洋点了点头：“绝对没有。要是楚弛有证据，尽管拿出来！楚弛，你有吗？”
楚弛没有说话，他怎么可能有证据。
那一晚在现场的姑娘，都死了。
这时，庞妃烟也开口道：“楚弛，没想到你会这样冤枉我……你真是让我，太寒心了，亏我今日还来为你烧纸钱。”
庞妃烟委屈得都快哭了。

楚弛摇了摇头，感叹道：“人不要脸，真的是天下无敌！行了，你也别装了。我不管大家信不信，庞妃烟，我就问你一句，你敢同我来一场生死战吗？”
楚弛这句话一出，全场哗然。
每个人都像是看怪物一样看着楚弛。
在飞云村，谁不知道楚弛是一个修炼废材！
楚庞两家的青年一辈中，就他一人怎么都无法感应到丹田。
他居然说要同庞妃烟来一场生死战？
送死战还差不多！
庞妃烟的天赋，虽然不好，却也不平庸，年仅十九岁，就已经是凡人境三层的修为，据说马上就要冲破第四条隐脉，步入凡人境四层。
“楚弛！赶紧收回你的话！你是得了失心疯了吧？”
“是啊，你这是自取其辱。会给我楚家丢脸的！”
“既然你没死，就别没事找事了！”
楚家年轻一辈，纷纷开口阻止。
他们看楚弛的眼神，非常嫌弃。
楚家二少爷楚枫更是拍了拍楚弛的肩膀，将嘴巴凑到楚弛耳边，小声开口道：“乖乖当你的纨绔废物，别给我楚家丢人。”
就连楚山都忍不住摇了摇头道：“看来，你是摔坏了脑袋，所以今日才胡言乱语。行了，散了吧。”
“我没摔坏脑子，也没失心疯。庞妃烟，我再问一次，你敢同我生死战吗？要是不敢，跪下求饶！”
楚弛厉声质问，声音猖狂。
“呵呵呵……我有何不敢？我迎战！”
庞妃烟笑了。
笑里，藏着刀！

既然楚弛没摔死，那就再杀一次。
反正，是这小子自寻死路！
content_en:
It’s come true…
Chu Chi's words kept floating around.
The sound is sonorous and soul-stirring!
Brush brush brush.
In just a moment, he attracted the attention of everyone present.
At this moment, he was the center of attention.
"Who are you! What nonsense are you talking about."
Pang Qingyang, the head of the Pang family, asked coldly.
"Who am I?"
Chu Chi sneered and pulled off the face towel.
At that moment, the whole place was silent!
Everyone's eyes widened, as if they couldn't believe their own eyes.
"It's the seventh young master...it's the seventh young master!"
"This is a human or a ghost."
Some of the timid servants had their faces changed with fear.
"There is a shadow! Young Master Seven is still alive."
Everyone took a closer look and saw that there was indeed a shadow under Chu Chi's body.
He is not a ghost, he is a human!
At this moment, the sun shines on Chu Chi's body, giving people a feeling of being so bright that they dare not look directly.
"Chu Chi!"
Opposite me, Pang Feiyan's pupils kept shrinking, and she was so surprised that she was speechless!
How could Chu Chi not die?
That is an abyss.
Anyone who falls will die, unless they can fly!
"I'm very satisfied with the look in your eyes now! Are you surprised why I'm still alive?"
Chu Chi grinned with a playful smile.
As he spoke, he looked at the head of the Chu family, his grandfather, Chu Shan.
"Grandpa, I know you never want to see me, but let me ask you, what will happen if the son of the Chu family suffers a great injustice?"
Chu Shan looked at Chu Chi silently, and said calmly: "If you have grievances, you will have grievances, and if you have vengeance, you will have revenge."
"Okay. Then please, grandpa, allow me to kill this bitch!"
Chu Chi pointed at Pang Feiyan's face, and a strong killing intent shot out from her body.
This murderous intention was noticed by everyone present.
"You want to kill Pang Feiyan? Don't you like her very much? What's going on?"
"Yes, Chu Chi, please speak more clearly."
"Okay."
Just when Chu Chi was about to explain, Pang Feiyan glanced at a Pang family member.
The other party understood, and suddenly shot out a hidden weapon from his wrist.
The hidden weapon hit Chu Chi directly in the face.
"Not good!"
The expressions of Chu Shan and the elders of the Chu family changed. With such a close distance, it was too late to take action.
Fortunately, Chu Chi stretched out his right hand and clamped the hidden weapon.
"Huh?"
Pang Feiyan's eyes were surprised. It was impossible for ordinary people to block this hidden weapon.
How did Chu Chi, this dandy loser, do it? Coincidence?
"People from the Pang family, are you too presumptuous? This is my Chu family!"
Chu Shan looked unhappy and went to Chu Chi to protect him personally.
"Chu Chi, please continue talking, what's going on..."
"Grandpa, I was framed by this bitch! That night..."
Chu Chi told his story.
After listening to his story, all the Chu family members present looked surprised.
No one expected that Chu Chi would go through such a frustrating thing.
However, judging from their expressions, it was obvious that they did not believe it.
Doesn’t Pang Feiyan look like someone who does these things?
Compared to Chu Chi, a dude, they seemed to rather believe in Pang Feiyan.
At this time, Chu Shan asked Pang Qingyang: "Old Pang, do you have anything to explain?"
Pang Qingyang asked: "What do you need to explain? You also saw the sun test stone shattered with your own eyes that night."
"Grandpa, the sun test stone that night was definitely fake."
"Fake?" Chu Shan frowned, and then continued, "In this case, our Chu family also has a sun test stone. Let's test it again. Chu Feng, go and get the sun test stone."
After saying this, Chu Chi quickly stopped Grandpa. How could he retake the test?
If you retest, the sun test stone will definitely break.
Because of this bitch, the blind cat met a dead mouse. He is really the ancient sun body.
In other words, if Pang Feiyan didn't make this show, he would really go berserk that night.
"Grandpa, there's no need to ask my second brother to get the sun test stone. I'm still alive now.Good proof? After all, I am twenty years old! "
Chu Chi's words made the Chu family suddenly realize.
"Yes, seven days have passed and Chu Chi has turned twenty. If he were the Great Ancient Sun, even if he didn't fall to death, he would still explode and die. "
"So, what he said is true? Is Pang Feiyan really so cruel? But why am I so reluctant to believe it? "
"Yeah, I don't believe it either. "
People in the Chu family still don't believe Chu Chi. This shows that Chu Chi's status in the Chu family is very low!
Only a girl of seventeen or eighteen years old gritted her teeth and said: "I believe Brother Qi, Brother Qi will never lie about this kind of thing. "
This woman, named Chu Yingying, is the eighth eldest child.
In the entire Chu family, apart from Chu Chi's biological brother Chu Tian, she has the best relationship with Chu Chi.
"Eight sisters, do you believe Chu Chi? "
"Well, could it be that Pang Feiyan felt that Seventh Brother was not a cultivator and was not worthy of her, so she came up with such a vicious plan to kill Seventh Brother? Pang Feiyan, maybe she is just a low-income girl! "
Chu Yingying's words made Pang Qingyang frown, and he said: "What Chu Chi said was his one-sided statement after all. Perhaps his memory that night was confused. I don't believe Feiyan would treat him like that. "
Chu Shan asked: "You mean, Fei Yan didn't drug him? "
Pang Qingyang nodded: "Absolutely not. If Chu Chi has evidence, just bring it out! Chuchi, do you have it? "
Chu Chi didn't say anything, how could he have evidence.
All the girls who were there that night died.
At this time, Pang Feiyan also said: "Chu Chi, I didn't expect you to wrongly accuse me like this... You really let me down, it's so chilling that I'm here to burn paper money for you today. "
Pang Feiyan was so wronged that she almost cried.
Chu Chi shook his head and sighed: "You are shameless, you are really invincible in the world! Okay, stop pretending. I don’t care if you believe it or not, Pang Feiyan, I just want to ask you, do you dare to have a life-and-death battle with me? "
As soon as Chu Chi said these words, the whole place was in an uproar.
Everyone looked at Chu Chi like a monster.
In Feiyun Village, who doesn't know that Chu Chi is a useless person in cultivation!
Among the young people of the Chu and Pang families, he was the only one who could not sense the Dantian.
He actually said that he wanted to have a life and death battle with Pang Feiyan?
Fighting to the death is almost enough!
Pang Feiyan's talent, although not good, is not mediocre. At only nineteen years old, she is already at the third level of the mortal realm. It is said that she will soon break through the fourth hidden vein and enter the fourth level of the mortal realm.
"Chu Chi! Take back your words quickly! Have you gone crazy after gaining or losing? "
“Yeah, you’re humiliating yourself. It will embarrass my Chu family! "
"Since you're not dead, don't look for trouble! "
The younger generation of the Chu family spoke to stop him one after another.
They looked at Chu Chi with disgust.
Chu Feng, the second young master of the Chu family, patted Chu Chi on the shoulder, put his mouth close to Chu Chi's ear, and whispered: "Be your dandy and loser, don't embarrass my Chu family. "
Even Chu Shan couldn't help but shook his head and said: "It seems that you broke your head, so you are talking nonsense today. Okay, let's break up. "
"I didn't break my brain, and I didn't lose my mind. Pang Feiyan, I ask again, do you dare to fight to the death with me? If you don’t dare, kneel down and beg for mercy! "
Chu Chi asked sternly, his voice wild.
"Hehehe... Why don't I dare? I'll fight! "
Pang Feiyan smiled.
There is a knife hidden in the smile!
Since Chu Chi didn't fall to death, let's kill him again.
Anyway, this kid is the one seeking his own death!
